snippet.title: Crabby Fishes Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Crabby Fishes is a fast-paced tower defense game where you protect a tropical island from polluting invaders.
Colorful visuals, quirky characters, and tactical challenges await!

🎮 Play the free demo on Steam and wishlist:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3547760/Crabby_Fishes?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=demo
